ratios.label: Gross margin
ratios.explain: What is left of each rupee of sales after the direct cost of what was sold.

ratios.label: Net margin
ratios.explain: What is left after everything, including rent and salaries.

ratios.label: Current ratio
ratios.explain: Short-term assets against short-term debts. Below 1 means you cannot cover what falls due.

ratios.label: Days sales outstanding
ratios.explain: How long money takes to arrive after a sale. Compare it against the terms you actually give.
